verdict: Lead volume and efficiency both declined this week; root causes are identified.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 93 leads at an average cost of $19.69 per lead, but the most recent 7-day window shows a 23% drop in leads alongside a 34% rise in cost per lead — a deterioration in efficiency, not a spend problem, as ad spend held nearly flat. The primary driver is a sharp pullback in organic activity: Google Business Profile actions fell 33% week-over-week and recorded zero actions on the final two days of the period, pulling pipeline down before paid ads even enter the picture. The Weston location is also converting impressions to calls at a rate far below the other profiles, and that gap is being investigated and addressed now. Next period, you should see stabilisation as the profile and organic issues are corrected; the paid campaigns themselves remain structurally sound.
